title: Learning candidate
description: A proposed skill, policy, schema or runbook derived from completed work. It is a CANDIDATE: learning does not self-activate, and an iteration may not make its own candidate authoritative unless a pre-existing adoption policy independently permits that exact class of change. Canonical serialization: UTF-8 JSON, keys sorted, separators (',',':'). Digest is sha256 over those bytes as 'sha256:<hex>'. Backward compatibility: additive optional fields are minor; removing a field, narrowing an enum or adding a required field is MAJOR and takes a new $id.

source_evidence.description: A generalisation from no identified observation is an opinion.

negative_cases.description: Required. A candidate with only positive cases has not been tested, it has been illustrated.

adopted.description: const false. Adoption is recorded by the adopting authority elsewhere; a candidate that can mark itself adopted is a candidate that self-activates.
